profile.subtitleJa: ケトラの子らの一人として系譜に名が挙がります。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: The sons of Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: she bore Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. The sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.

wikipediaCheck.identityBasisJa: Dedicated URL redirects to the Keturah article. Its “Medan” subsection, lines 203–207, names Medan as a son of Abraham and Keturah; the references at line 236 cite 1 Chronicles 1:32–33.
